entities.name: Olavo Setúbal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Olavo Egydio Setúbal was a Brazilian industrialist, banker and politician. He had served as Mayor of São Paulo from 1975 to 1979, Minister of Foreign Affairs from 1985 to 1986, and chairman of the Itaúsa conglomerate from 2001 until his death in 2008.
